visualInspection.method: Saved Chromium PNGs opened with view_image
visualInspection.findings: Actual product photos visible behind high-contrast names/info/controls; clean separate offer panel shows price once, compact desktop field text, usable mobile fields. Failed photo produces a solid background with no question glyph.

knownPerformanceObservation: On repeated mobile navigations Chromium may request optimized hidden desktop cart backgrounds despite lazy/low attributes; the mobile dialog itself is unmounted before opening. Zero hidden requests is not claimed. Plan: render decorative images only after IntersectionObserver confirms a visible photo frame in the next batch.
